Yes to both. When I archive something, I'm setting it aside, so it makes sense for it to drop out of both my main list and my read-later pile while it's tucked away — I wouldn't want an archived thing still nagging me from the reading queue.

And on restoring, bringing it back to All bookmarks is what I'd expect. I wouldn't want it silently jumping back into my read-later pile on its own; if I decide I still want to read it later, I can just mark it that way again. So restore to the main library only is right.
